state_candidate.units: cm^2 water per unit horizontal area under the depth-in-cm convention
state_candidate.physical_interpretation: Signed vertical displacement of retained water content within the layer relative to its centroid; distinguishes top-heavy from bottom-heavy subgrid moisture distributions at identical total storage.
state_candidate.dynamic_state_increment: one scalar only for each layer selected for moment enrichment

derivation: Integrate by parts over centered coordinate z-z_c.
No empirical coefficient or unresolved source term is introduced; the remaining quantity is the layer integral of the reconstructed Darcy flux.

conservation_native_reconstruction_hiera.coordinate: volumetric water content theta, the conserved field itself
reason_for_coordinate: S_i and M_i are moments of theta, so polynomial moment constraints are direct linear functionals of the reconstruction variable.
This avoids selecting pressure head versus suction versus Kirchhoff potential solely as an arbitrary profile coordinate.
Hydraulic pressure psi(theta) and K(theta) remain constitutive algebraic functions used in Darcy flux and interface conditions.
global_constraints: one storage constraint for every layer
one first-moment constraint for every enriched layer
pressure/suction continuity at every internal interface
Darcy flux continuity at every internal interface

degree_count.conclusion: The mixed quadratic/cubic theta hierarchy is square for any prospectively selected set of moment-enriched layers.

minimality_claim.claim: A single centered first moment is the smallest scalar dynamic augmentation beyond S_i that carries within-layer vertical shape information and has an exact balance derivable directly from Richards conservation.
boundaries: This does not prove that one moment per enriched layer is sufficient for hydrological fidelity.
A square nonlinear algebraic system does not guarantee existence, uniqueness or admissibility.
The theta-polynomial reconstruction is a new projection hypothesis, although it is conservation-native rather than selected from exposed response error.

C4K_reconciliation.retained_fact: C4K remains valid for its A2 direction/history near-collision diagnostic.
why_new_read_only_state_route_is_now_aut: C4K explicitly did not establish universal memoryless sufficiency.
C5V later proved storage-only subgrid shape underdetermination for the Layer-ROM propagation problem.
C5W prospectively rejected the minimum-additional-structure P0 algebraic closure on existence/admissibility before any hydrological response.
The new state is not introduced to encode RISE/FALL history labels; it represents a missing spatial moment of the conserved field.

independent_theory_context.relevance: Richards discretizations naturally separate conserved moisture content from algebraic hydraulic variables and use basis/weighted-residual representations; this supports a projection hierarchy but does not prove the proposed moment basis is uniquely optimal.
Mass conservation can be enforced together with local polynomial representations and interface flux constraints, supporting the mathematical form of a conservation-native polynomial hierarchy.

independent_theory_context.relevance: Water-content moments have established physical interpretations for location/spread of subsurface water, though prior uses do not constitute a reduced Richards closure proof.
